tasks.label: 🔄 Pull Common Subtree - Server
tasks.command: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && git subtree pull --prefix=source-code/mmria/common https://github.com/CDCgov/nccdphp-drh-mmria-common.git main --squash -m 'Merge subtree: nccdphp-drh-mmria-common'

tasks.label: ⬆️ Push Common Subtree - Server
args: Copy-Item -Path 'source-code/mmria/common/*' -Destination '../nccdphp-drh-mmria-common/' -Recurse -Force; Push-Location '../nccdphp-drh-mmria-common'; git add .; if (git status --porcelain) { git commit -m "Sync from main repo $(Get-Date -Format yyyy-MM-dd) $(Get-Date -Format HH:mm)"; git pull --rebase origin main; git push origin main; if ($?) { Write-Host '✅ Pushed!' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '❌ Push failed!' -ForegroundColor Red } } else { Write-Host 'No changes' -ForegroundColor Yellow }; Pop-Location
